registry_entry.gated: manual: request access to Llama 3.1 on huggingface.co with your account, then `hf auth login` on Hopper
registry_entry.why: 'Version 3.1' plus the Dubey et al. (2024) citation, which is the Llama 3.1 ('Llama 3 Herd') paper. Instruct, not base, because the paper's prompt is a chat prompt with a system part ('You are a helpful AI assistant...'). The paper calls Llama/Mistral 'base models', but its v1 README also labels GPT-3.5 'Base', so there 'base' means general-purpose (not code-tuned), not pretrained-only.

protocol.purpose: Primary, paper-comparable. The paper defines pass@1 as passing all tests 'on its first attempt'; greedy decoding is the deterministic version of one attempt, and is how the EvalPlus leaderboard reports pass@1. This run also feeds the manual code-cleaning track.
